item.title: Teenage Engineering OPXY // Sparkling Water
item.description: video upload by Dexba "Caught the flu, locked in bed, brought the OPXY with me because JAMuary doesn't stop. I wanted to play something soothing, but still with a kick, and here we are! OPXY is slowly teaching me how to lay down drums, and I just wish it had more parameters to mess with, à-la-tracker. Maybe I should get a tracker? 😄 I hope you'll enjoy it!"
